nphi.title: WHO CC on behavioural science for emergency preparedness: partnerships with Slovenia, Spain and Ireland
nphi.with: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ); Instituto de Salud Carlos III (ISCIII); Department of Health, Ireland
nphi.summary: RIVM's WHO Collaborating Centre on behavioural science for emergency preparedness is working with public health bodies in Slovenia, Spain and Ireland. The partners use an RIVM-designed survey (e.g. Slovenia's twice-yearly SI-PANDA survey)…

nphi.title: EpiGen Ethiopia – Building scalable pathogen genomic epidemiology for Ethiopia
nphi.with: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI); Armauer Hansen Research Institute; Ethiopian Ministry of Health; Arsi, Jimma, Bahir Dar and Hawassa universities; St Paul's Millennium Medical College; Heinrich-Heine-Universität Düsseldorf; ISGlobal; PharmAccess; Africa CDC (core partner)
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project building a national genomics-based surveillance system in Ethiopia, with EPHI and AHRI as national sequencing centres linked to 30 IDSR sites and a shared data platform.

nphi.title: MPX-RESPONSE – Clinical research network to improve the management of mpox
nphi.with: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Fiocruz); Norwegian Institute of Public Health (Folkehelseinstituttet); Fundación Huésped; Oslo University Hospital; ECRAID; UMC Utrecht; Erasmus MC; University of Antwerp; University of Verona; APHP; PANDEMIC platform
nphi.summary: Horizon Europe clinical research network studying mpox treatment and management, including trials and cohorts in Europe and Latin America, with Fiocruz and the Norwegian Institute of Public Health as participants.

nphi.title: JUA-KIVU – Clade I mpox epidemiology, evolution and immunology in South Kivu
nphi.with: Rwanda Biomedical Centre; Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Burundi; Stansile Ltd (scientific lead); Université Catholique de Bukavu; Good Samaritan Foundation (KCMC); Technical University of Denmark; University of Castilla-La Mancha
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 study of the origin, spread and immune responses of clade Ib mpox in eastern DRC, involving the national public health institutes of Rwanda (RBC) and Burundi (INSP).

nphi.title: QUANTUM – quality and utility labels for health data (EHDS)
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: Instituto Aragonés de Ciencias de la Salud (coordinator); 35 partner organisations
nphi.summary: Project developing quality and utility labels for health data for the European Health Data Space, with 35 organisations across 14 countries including Norway.

nphi.title: CLIMOS – Climate monitoring and decision support for sand fly-borne diseases
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); Ministry of Health of Türkiye; Ministry of Health of Israel; Italian Ministry of Health; Hacettepe and Ege universities; University of Haifa; Institute for Medical Research Belgrade; Charles University; Wageningen University; INSERM; UFZ; KIT
nphi.summary: Horizon Europe climate-and-health project building an early-warning and decision-support framework for sand fly-borne diseases (e.g. leishmaniasis) under climate change across the Mediterranean, with Italy's ISS and Turkish, Israeli and…

nphi.title: TESA II – Trials of Excellence in Southern Africa II
nphi.with: Uganda National Health Research Organisation; Health Research Centre of Angola; Biomedical Research and Training Institute; Blantyre Health Research & Training Trust; Botswana-Harvard AIDS Institute; ECRIN; ISGlobal; AIGHD; UCL; Stellenbosch University; University of Namibia; University Teaching Hospital Zambia
nphi.summary: EDCTP2 regional network of excellence strengthening clinical trial capacity in Southern Africa through training and shared infrastructure; Uganda's national health research organisation took part as partner.

nphi.title: ZIKAlliance – A global alliance for Zika virus control and prevention
nphi.with: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Fiocruz); Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública (INSP Mexico); Norwegian Institute of Public Health (Folkehelseinstituttet); Institut Pasteur; Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social; Universidad Industrial de Santander; Institut Louis Malardé (French Polynesia); Bernhard-Nocht-Institut
nphi.summary: Horizon 2020 multidisciplinary consortium of 50+ partners studying Zika virus natural history, pregnancy outcomes and vector control across Latin America and the Caribbean. NPHIs from Brazil, Mexico, Norway and France took part.

nphi.title: EAVI – European-African Vaccine Initiative against chikungunya in sub-Saharan Africa
nphi.with: Instituto de Salud Carlos III (ISCIII); Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI, trial sponsor); Ifakara Health Institute (scientific lead); Valneva Austria; EPFL; Karolinska Institutet
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 partnership running a phase IIIb chikungunya vaccine trial in Kenya and Tanzania and preparing master protocols for future NTD vaccine trials; Spain's ISCIII and KEMRI participate.

nphi.title: SINCEP-Africa – Institutional networks and capacity for epidemiological preparedness in Africa
nphi.with: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Côte d'Ivoire; Ghana Health Service; Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine; PANDORA platform (France); Fundação Manhiça; Ifakara Health Institute; Makerere University; Université de Kinshasa; CNRST-IRSS; Universidad de Navarra; CTI Africa
nphi.type: Network (Global Health EDCTP3 network of excellence)
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 coordination action turning INDEPTH community-based health surveillance sites into trial-ready sites for outbreaks, with Côte d'Ivoire's INSP hosting a new site.

nphi.title: EpiScientia Network – Data science and epidemiology capacity in African national public health institutes
nphi.with: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI); Rwanda Biomedical Centre; Instituto Nacional de Saúde (INS) Mozambique; African Union; Réseau Africain de Recherche en Santé; IRSP Ouidah; Ghent University; IDIAP Jordi Gol; LSHTM; Heritage Alliance
nphi.summary: Five-year Global Health EDCTP3 European-African consortium building data science, epidemiology and health informatics skills inside national public health institutes through work-based training and a federated health data platform.

nphi.title: ISCIII–INSP Mexico memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública (INSP), Mexico
nphi.summary: A 2025 scientific cooperation framework covering infectious diseases, surveillance, AMR, pandemic preparedness, nutrition, digital health and climate-health, under ISCIII's international health missions programme for Latin America.

nphi.title: JA PRISM – mental health promotion in vulnerable groups
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: Biosistemak Institute for Health Systems Research (coordinator); 60 organisations in 20 countries
nphi.summary: Joint Action with 18 EU states plus Montenegro and Bosnia and Herzegovina; NIJZ pilots the Act-Belong-Commit approach in schools.

nphi.title: JADE Health – Joint Action addressing Dementia and Health
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: FUNDESALUD (Spain, beneficiary); 47 entities in 17 countries
nphi.summary: EU Joint Action on dementia with 17 countries including Norway and Ukraine; Slovenian pilot on awareness and stigma reduction.

nphi.title: ISCIII–Fiocruz memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Fiocruz)
nphi.summary: ISCIII and Fiocruz signed an MoU on science and health cooperation in March 2024, followed by an institutional visit in April 2024.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 110 – One Health Secure
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); CSIC; IRD; IZS Teramo; AVIA-GIS
nphi.summary: EU CBRN Centres of Excellence project in which Institut Pasteur and Italy's ISS, with veterinary and research partners, help Mediterranean, Black Sea and Sahel countries prepare for climate-sensitive vector-borne diseases through One…

nphi.title: Ebola PREP-TBOX – Toolbox for Sudan ebolavirus outbreak preparedness
nphi.with: Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB) DRC; Uganda National Health Research Organisation; UVRI Clinical Research Program Initiative; Fondation Congolaise pour la Recherche Médicale (scientific lead); Hospital 12 de Octubre research foundation; CNRS; Fabentech
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project building detection, treatment and public health response tools for Sudan ebolavirus outbreaks, with DRC's INRB and Uganda's national health research organisation/UVRI.

nphi.title: EBO-PEP – Ebola Zaire post-exposure prophylaxis preparedness and efficacy evaluation
nphi.with: INSERM (coordinator); Agence Nationale de Sécurité Sanitaire (ANSS) Guinea; ALIMA; PANDEMIC platform; ISGlobal; Université de Bordeaux; PAC-CI; Université Gamal Abdel Nasser de Conakry; UCAD; MSF Belgium
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 trial led scientifically by DRC's INRB with Guinea's national health security agency ANSS, testing monoclonal antibodies as post-exposure prophylaxis for Ebola contacts and building rapid-trial infrastructure.

nphi.title: JANE-2 – Joint Action on Networks of Expertise
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: Fondazione IRCCS Istituto Nazionale dei Tumori (lead); beneficiaries in 16 countries incl. Norway
nphi.summary: EU Joint Action on networks of expertise with 16 beneficiary countries including Norway; NIJZ is the Slovenian representative.

nphi.title: EU-WISH – EU Wastewater Integrated Surveillance for Public Health
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: Norwegian Institute of Public Health; Statens Serum Institut (supporting organisation); partners from 26 countries
nphi.summary: EU4Health Joint Action with partners in 26 countries (incl. non-EU Norway and Ukraine) to strengthen wastewater-based surveillance of biological and chemical agents.

nphi.title: Fiocruz – ISGlobal framework agreement
nphi.with: Barcelona Institute for Global Health (ISGlobal)
nphi.summary: Framework international cooperation agreement between Fiocruz and ISGlobal.

nphi.title: ISCIII tropical medicine cooperation with Equatorial Guinea
nphi.actor: Instituto de Salud Carlos III (ISCIII) – Centro Nacional de Medicina Tropical
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Social Welfare of Equatorial Guinea; Fundación CSAI
nphi.summary: ISCIII's National Centre for Tropical Medicine supports Equatorial Guinea's HIV, TB, malaria and NTD programmes and advises on hospital reference units; a 2024 institutional field visit reviewed the cooperation.

nphi.title: Lancet Countdown Europe 2026 report presentation with national success stories
nphi.with: Santé publique France; Austrian Climate and Health Competence Centre; Heidelberg University; ISGlobal; European Environment Agency; WHO Europe

nphi.title: Mapping onchocerciasis, lymphatic filariasis and loiasis in continental Equatorial Guinea
nphi.with: MINSABS national onchocerciasis and filariasis control programme; Probitas Foundation; WHO ESPEN
nphi.summary: ISCIII-led project, co-funded by Probitas and WHO ESPEN, to map filarial diseases in continental Equatorial Guinea, evaluate new diagnostics and support control strategies with the national programme.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 075 – MediLabSecure (One Health biological risks in the Mediterranean, Black Sea and Sahel)
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); IRD; INIA; IZS Teramo; Avia-GIS
nphi.summary: EU-funded network led by Institut Pasteur with Italy's ISS that strengthened laboratories and public health institutions in 22 neighbouring countries to detect and respond to arboviruses and their vectors, including external quality…

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 048 – Improved regional management of outbreaks in the African Atlantic Façade
nphi.with: Expertise France; Institut Pasteur; Fondation Mérieux; IRD; French Ministry of Health; CNCMFE NRBC-E; FIIAPP
nphi.summary: EU-funded project in which Santé publique France, Institut Pasteur and other French and Spanish bodies built outbreak preparedness and rapid-response teams in 11 West and Central African countries after the Ebola epidemic.

nphi.title: MediPIET – Mediterranean and Black Sea Programme for Intervention Epidemiology Training
nphi.with: FIIAPP; FCSAI; ECDC (scientific lead); national public health authorities of partner countries
nphi.summary: An EU-initiated field epidemiology fellowship for Mediterranean and Black Sea countries. ISCIII co-implemented it with FIIAPP (2014–2017) and FCSAI (2018–2021); ECDC ran it alone from 2021 to 2025.

nphi.title: EpiSouth Mediterranean/Balkan communicable disease network
nphi.with: Institutes leading work packages in France, Bulgaria and Greece; Spanish national public health institute (training); Padua Teaching Hospital; 26 member countries in total across southern Europe, the Balkans, North Africa and the Middle East (not all named in the article)
nphi.summary: An ISS-coordinated network linking public health institutes and ministries around the Mediterranean and in the Balkans. Its work covered cross-border epidemic intelligence, vaccine-preventable diseases and migrants, emerging zoonoses, and…
